_readme: Update policy, compared against the BUILD number (the +N in pubspec.yaml). latestBuild = dismissible prompt. minBuild = BLOCKING, and needs latestBuild set too or the client downgrades it to a prompt. READ THIS BEFORE SETTING latestVersion: it is not a label, it is the version the iOS client demands the App Store already be serving before it will block (return !_isNewer(wanted, live) in update_service.dart). Builds 108 and older query itunes.apple.com/lookup WITHOUT a country parameter, which once answered a stale version for weeks; builds after that cache-bust the lookup. Check that every spelling (no country, &country=se, &country=us) reports the version before setting it here - on 2026-10-26 all three answered 1.7.4. Set it to a version the store actually reports, not the one in pubspec.yaml. minBuild is what does the real gating. ALSO: the update dialog could not appear at all in builds 100-108 - UpdateGate showed it on a context above the Navigator and showDialog threw every time. Fixed in build 109. Nothing set here reaches a user on 108 or below; they arrive on a working build through ordinary store updates. ANDROID: 1.7.4 (113) released on Play 2026-10-30; latestBuild 113 offers it, minBuild stays 1 so nobody is locked out. Android has no store check before blocking, so only raise minBuild once Play has rolled a build out to 100%.
